title: Arthur Young's Reflexive Universe: spirit descends into matter and returns

tellings.quote: the process the whole universal process is one of spirit descending into matter and then matter ascending back into the realm of spirit.

plain: A thinker named Arthur Young held that the whole universe is "spirit descending into matter and then matter ascending back into the realm of spirit," an idea from his 1976 book The Reflexive Universe. A guest with a doctorate named Jeffrey Mishlove passes this on, as something Young taught. If it holds, it would make the physical world one stage in a round trip that ends back in spirit.
